assessment: The four authored marking layers give a real improvement within this proof-row representation: all five cases resolved in under 0.12 seconds, versus four for the original model and three for expanded marks-off under the two-second cap. This is evidence for the bounded normal-form encoding, not an advantage over conventional proof search. Exact bounded fact-set BFS resolved all five in about 0.00028–0.00044 seconds. The RL policy changed its weights, but every training reward was positive and learned/random evaluation had identical recorded choices, event-stream hashes and selections. No RL benefit is supported.
custody: One owned 24.49-second scientific worker; 273 retained files and 269 complete raw artifacts. Every one of 28 benchmark/training certificates passed the actual native C1 program and independent B checker. Full archive publication is explicitly authorized by the user.
headline: Normalization resolved all five evaluation cases. Learned and random preferences made identical recorded choices; bounded fact-set BFS remained much faster.
learning_summary: Nine episodes produced nine parameter updates, all with verified positive rewards. Only six training calls offered distinct projected base moves. Learned and random policies made identical choices in all 129 evaluation callbacks. Parameter movement alone is not evidence of useful learning.

claim_limits.checking: Whole candidate reconstruction and selected t/m/flatproof checking independently implemented. Unchanged native C1 program plus independent FOL checker required for every reported successful benchmark/training search proof. A clipped event prefix is not a complete independent search-tree exhaustion certificate.
claim_limits.clusters: Two-MP partial clusters are automatically mined from actual S point certificates, generalized through formula receptors, and statically instantiated. Internal t/m compatibility is checked. The callback sees only a currently legal member at the selected root; it cannot certify the other member against the current whole state. It supplies a preference for a single legal base placement, not an accepted cluster transaction or macro. Complete base fallback remains.
claim_limits.domain: Finite anchored point IDs. Required slot:i each has capacity1. Each candidate carries exactly one unit t and finitely many literal string-valued m assignments outside requiredQ. Missing m is unconstrained; strings0 and1 are real values.
claim_limits.engine: Unchanged S singleton-unit engine. Complete forward/reverse incidence and all remote marking dependency lists. All explicitly activated roots have generation0 and all placed tiles generation1. Global dead precedes global forced; otherwise count/key tie-break within generation0. Exact trail inverse and parent-scoped failed-child exclusions.
claim_limits.inventory: Complete S GIVEN/MP inventory for every earlier reference pair over the finite input subformula catalogue. Expanded lanes add the same nonfinal PADDING aliases. OFF/ON differ only by m. No cluster proposal replaces base incidence.
claim_limits.learning: A bounded stochastic REINFORCE preference pilot. Reward is native+independently VERIFIED success or an explicitly declared resource-performance penalty for other capped outcomes. No timeout becomes a logical negative. Freeze before structural evaluation. Actual choices, nonzero updates, equal proposal inventory, data acquisition and all costs must be examined before any learning claim.
claim_limits.limits: Prospective cold lane construction/proposal/search wall limits; separate audits/storage/proof checks; owned whole-worker observer. Sampled RSS and cooperative timing are not hard OS quotas. Every failure/UNKNOWN and any incomplete study remain recorded.
claim_limits.normalization: Human-authored proof-existence quotient for GIVEN/MP only, not a rule preserving every original tiling. Four literal m layers enforce phase, sorted real hypotheses, unique real output formulas, and no references to padding. No failure-trained marking learner in this study.
remaining_gaps: Fractional t, multisupport tile placements and growing physical frontiers are outside this finite specialized engine.
No current-interface validated whole-cluster execution or hierarchical macro transactions.
No new failure-trained markings, turtle/Penrose result, plane-tiling proof or substitution result.
No full first-order proof-structure search, induction, Hilbert geometry, established ATP benchmark result, universality construction or superiority claim.
claim_limits.transformations: Anchored symbolic translations/row-reference placements only; no rotations, reflections or physical edge geometry. This is a symbolic point-tile adaptation, not a fixed finite classical Wang palette.
